overview: This House resolution assigns Representatives to two House committees: Ms. Pingree and Mr. Carbajal to the Committee on Agriculture, which handles farm, food, and nutrition policy, and Mr. Schneider and Ms. Dean of Pennsylvania to the Committee on Foreign Affairs, which handles diplomacy and foreign aid. Resolutions like this are the routine way each party's picks for committee seats are formally approved by the full House. It does not change any law or policy. The House agreed to it on February 25, 2025.
for: Supporters say filling these seats lets the Agriculture and Foreign Affairs committees work with full membership for the new Congress.
against: Critics say this is a routine housekeeping measure that only fills committee seats and doesn't change any law or spending.
